requirement.title: Real-engine RefactorKit integration in the IDE daemon
requirement.classification: Story BDD + Spec BDD for pure view-model decisions
requirement.capability: The RefactorKit daemon delegates to the REAL refactorkit engine (CLI at /home/paperboy/workspace/refactorkit, wrapper on PATH) instead of a deterministic fixture peer, for the operational surface: scan, symbols, definition, references, diagnostics, and the 6 refactoring operations (rename-class/rename-member/rename-local-variable/move-class/change-method-signature/safe-delete). Real-engine preview is read-only (no write before explicit authority); apply performs the real transformation bound to the exact reviewed plan + explicit approval; rollback when advertised. Honest unavailable when the engine is not discoverable or an operation is unsupported.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a Java workspace, the daemon discovers the real refactorkit engine (wrapper/PATH + installed path) and reports capabilities authoritatively; honest unavailable when the engine is not discoverable.

Real-engine preview for a named refactoring operation returns an immutable patch plan (create/edit/move/delete + review evidence) that is read-only — no workspace write before explicit authority; the preview is correlated to operation/target/authority/generation/selection.

Apply runs the real engine transformation bound to the exact reviewed plan + explicit approval authority and reports applied/refused/stale/failed honestly; rollback only when advertised; no fabricated plan/success.

The flow follows extract -> delegate -> response with no hidden domain policy; browser adapter remains honest-unavailable; web-first boundary: packages/ui, packages/web-core, apps/web never import @tauri-apps/api.

Status is evidence-based with an explicit state (@implemented-and-validated | @implemented-not-e2e-validated | ...), never inferred from shells; live Tauri-window refactoring E2E may remain unvalidated if headless (recorded honestly).

requirement.owner: bdd-ts-domain-expert (domain research) + bdd-ts-gherkin-writer (feature) + ts-story-driven (Story) + tauri-rust-coder (daemon real-engine delegation) + tauri-adapter-coder + browser-adapter-coder + frontend-core-coder/frontend-app-coder (view-model + controller)
